stock.description: ZJLD Group Inc operates within the Chinese market, specializing in the production and distribution of distilled spirits. The company manages a portfolio of brands, notably Zhen Jiu, Li Du, Xiang Jiao, Kai Kou Xiao, and Shao Yang, among others. Founded in 2021, its corporate headquarters are located in Beijing, China. As of April 17, 2023, ZJLD Group Inc functions as a subsidiary entity of Zhenjiu Holding Limited.
